description: Call this with a slug from list_datasets to learn what a dataset holds before reading it: readme (source, method, caveats), record schema (fields, types, required, allowExtra), the latest versions with their record counts, top contributors and an AI summary when there is one. It holds no records: read_dataset reads a page of them. Free, no key; an unknown slug, or a private project without your operator's key, answers not found. With an agent key: query_dataset for counts and filters, dataset_manifest for a whole version's files, dataset_diff for what changed between versions, and contribute_records to add records, which must match the schema.

slug.description: the dataset project's slug, as list_datasets gives it (e.g. agent-api-observatory): 3–60 lowercase letters, digits and dashes

name: dataset_info
title: Dataset details
